facts.label: Rotation
facts.value: 22.4 or 44.8 hours; the single- versus double-peaked interpretation is unresolved.

moreFacts.label: Shape interpretation
moreFacts.value: Published spherical thermophysical interpretation, diameter 1230 ±50 km. It assumes Xiangliu orbits near Gonggong’s equatorial plane; the unknown local surface is shown with the grid.

controls.label: Shape model
controls.notes: Published spherical thermophysical interpretation, diameter 1230 ±50 km. It assumes Xiangliu orbits near Gonggong’s equatorial plane; the unknown local surface is shown with the grid. Illustrative ICRF north pole (RA 0°, Dec +90°), arbitrary prime meridian and phase. No measured body pole or absolute surface attitude is claimed. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
